definitions.explanation: a small balloon filled with water, used as a toy or in festival games

notes:
A common summer toy in Japan. Small, colorful water balloons are a staple at Japanese summer festivals (⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧), where {水風船|みずふうせん}すくい (water balloon scooping) is a popular game — players try to scoop floating water balloons with a paper hook.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水風船|みずふうせん}すくい: water balloon scooping (festival game)
- {水風船|みずふうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧: to throw water balloons
- {水風船|みずふうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}る→割る：02334_waru⟧: to pop a water balloon
- {水風船|みずふうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make water balloons

CULTURAL NOTE:
At Japanese summer festivals, {水風船|みずふうせん}すくい stalls feature a tub of colorful floating water balloons. Players use a paper hook (⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧こより) to try to lift them out before the hook dissolves. The scooped balloons are kept as prizes.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{風船|ふうせん}→風船：14623_fuusen⟧: balloon
- ヨーヨー: yo-yo water balloon (another festival variant)
- ⟦{金魚|きんぎょ}すくい→金魚すくい：14661_kingyosukui⟧: goldfish scooping (another classic festival game)
